clips.speaker: Jarrett Allen
clips.text: I felt like he adjusted very well to what we were doing. We had plenty of reps in training camp, but to do it all on the court in that level amount of time, I thought it went excellent for the team.
clips.news_angle: Jarrett Allen on Evan Mobley's integration into the starting lineup

clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Jarrett Allen Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: I felt like he adjusted very well to what we were doing.

clips.speaker: Jarrett Allen
clips.text: Switchability, three-point shooting, athleticism. Honestly, his athleticism is going to be huge for us. His ability to stab on one play and get back to his man and be able to contest another shot.
clips.news_angle: Jarrett Allen on Evan Mobley's specific contributions to the team

clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Jarrett Allen Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: His athleticism is going to be huge for us.

clips.speaker: Jarrett Allen
clips.text: For me, I had to learn on the fly. You don't know all the plays coming out when you get traded mid-season. But for Evan Mobley, he's been here two weeks before training camp, so he's understood the system, how we play, how the locker room works. He's understanding everything. He has time to adjust.
clips.news_angle: Jarrett Allen on the benefits of Evan Mobley having a full training camp

clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Jarrett Allen Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: He's understood the system, how we play, how the locker room works.

clips.speaker: Jarrett Allen
clips.text: It's huge and we're able to get his input on a lot of things. Last season, you don't really want to change too many things up during the season, especially when you're getting so close to the postseason. But now, his input means a lot to how much it's going to change the offense and defense.
clips.news_angle: Jarrett Allen on the value of James Harden's input during training camp

clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Jarrett Allen Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: We're able to get his input on a lot of things.

clips.speaker: Jarrett Allen
clips.text: It's super exciting. He's an excellent pick-and-roll player. You can call him one of the best. I feel like I'm pretty good at pick-and-roll myself and we're able to adjust to any type of defense at any time.
clips.news_angle: Jarrett Allen on the pick-and-roll chemistry with James Harden
clips.social_post: Jarrett Allen is excited about his pick-and-roll chemistry with James Harden, calling him one of the best in the league at running the action.
clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Jarrett Allen Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: He's an excellent pick-and-roll player. You can call him one of the best.

clips.speaker: Jarrett Allen
clips.text: He took a lot of that to heart. He's a competitor. At the end of the day, he wants to be on the court, he wants to fight and go against the best guys. I think he has every right to be upset with himself, but I think he's going to let that get to his mind too much and his next step is just understanding that, yeah, he did get fooled, but learn from that and grow from that and be a better player next time.
clips.news_angle: Jarrett Allen on Jaylen Brown's competitive mindset heading into the season

clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Jarrett Allen Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: He's a competitor. At the end of the day, he wants to be on the court.

clips.speaker: Jarrett Allen
clips.text: The conversations are good. I had the conversation during the game. It was like, I guess this is what Malik Beasley, but with Jaylen Brown as well. It was like, Malik thought he could get over a screen and I was calling a different coverage. I had to tell the young fella, I called the screen, you got to listen to me. I told him, if the play messes up, that's on me. You're just listening to the guy in the back and do it well. But they're all receptive, they're all willing to learn, they're all willing to grow.
clips.news_angle: Jarrett Allen on holding teammates accountable for defensive breakdowns

clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Jarrett Allen Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: I called the screen, you got to listen to me.

clips.speaker: Jarrett Allen
clips.text: Donovan Mitchell the other day talked about Tyrese Haliburton, kind of now going to that stage where Jaylen Brown was last year, second-year jump. The expectation is still to grow, especially for somebody in Tyrese's shoes who hasn't got a lot of minutes on the actual NBA court. But still to prove what you have. He's an excellent NBA player. clips.news_angle: Jarrett Allen on the development expectations for Tyrese Haliburton

clips.pull_quote: Now it's time to actually get on the court when the minutes matter.

clips.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
clips.text: I think teams have realized that's a competitive advantage. The possession game is a big part of winning in the NBA, so rebounding is obviously half of that and you got the turnovers. So you got those two things. I think teams have realized that's a competitive advantage.
clips.news_angle: Kenny Atkinson on the drastic changes in offensive rebounding
clips.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says offensive rebounding is a major competitive advantage in the modern NBA, noting that the possession game is a huge part of winning.
clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: I think teams have realized that's a competitive advantage.

clips.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
clips.text: The example would be the other night when Boston got 15 more shots up than us, and it's very simple math. They get 15 more shots, it's really hard to win if they get that many more shots.
clips.news_angle: Kenny Atkinson on the impact of shot volume differences
clips.social_post: Kenny Atkinson points to the math of shot volume, noting it is very hard to win when an opponent gets 15 more shots up than you.
clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: Boston got 15 more shots up than us, and it's very simple math.

clips.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
clips.text: The other thing is the perimeter crashing. It's literally the sprint from the three-point line into the paint. That's a different type of rebounding, box out, than maybe the scrum box out. We worked on it today. We got to be better. It's not just Celtics specific, I think it's league specific.
clips.news_angle: Kenny Atkinson on the impact of perimeter crashing
clips.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavs are working on perimeter crashing, noting that sprinting from the three point line into the paint is a different type of box out.
clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: It's the perimeter crashing. It's literally the sprint from the three-point line into the paint.

clips.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
clips.text: We have to go meet them with force, not let force come to us. That makes like physics, right? We're kind of following the ball and they're coming at us and they're on our backs and they kind of hit us and then we're out of soul. So we have to go and meet them.
clips.news_angle: Kenny Atkinson on the need to meet opponents with force
clips.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says the Cavs need to meet opponents with force rather than letting force come to them to avoid getting pushed around on the glass.
clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: We have to go meet them with force, not let force come to us.

clips.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
clips.text: With the perimeter box outs, there's more space to go around the box out if that makes sense. It's harder in space to box out, so we showed it on film obviously and then we got to keep working on our technique with that box out.
clips.news_angle: Kenny Atkinson on the difficulty of boxing out in space
clips.social_post: Kenny Atkinson explains that boxing out in space is difficult, which is why the team is focusing on technique to handle perimeter rebounding.
clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: With the perimeter box outs, there's more space to go around the box out.

clips.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
clips.text: I think Mario can be really good at it. I think Peyton can be really good at it. We had one in the first or second possession where we got kicked it out and we got a three. It's just become part of the game, a big part of the game, and then related to the possession game.
clips.news_angle: Kenny Atkinson on the rebounding potential of new players
clips.social_post: Kenny Atkinson sees potential for Mario and Peyton to be strong rebounders as the team continues to emphasize the possession game.
clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: I think Mario can be really good at it. I think Peyton can be really good at it.

clips.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
clips.text: I want to strike that balance, because he's a talented offensive player where I don't want him to be frozen and put him in a box. So I think right now I'm leaning more towards freedom, freedom to play, and I think that will help us observe him more and get to know his game more.
clips.news_angle: Kenny Atkinson on balancing freedom for offensive players
clips.social_post: Kenny Atkinson says he is leaning toward giving his talented offensive players more freedom right now so he can better observe and understand their games.
clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: I want to strike that balance, because he's a talented offensive player.

clips.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
clips.text: Another piece that's become more important is understanding how the game's being called, understanding and interpreting these new points of emphasis, educating the players. As coaches, I have to be educated. If I question a call, I want to be educated so I can speak on it correctly.
clips.news_angle: Kenny Atkinson on the importance of understanding officiating
clips.social_post: Kenny Atkinson emphasizes the importance of coaches and players staying educated on how the game is being called and understanding new points of emphasis.
clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: Another piece that's become more important is understanding how the game's being called.

clips.speaker: Kenny Atkinson
clips.text: Jared and Evan, I don't know what they have taken a step up communication wise and it's been a progressively they've gotten better at it. Jared particularly, I've noticed in the preseason, a lot louder, a lot more vocal, and Evan's getting better too.
clips.news_angle: Kenny Atkinson on the communication growth of young players
clips.social_post: Kenny Atkinson has noticed growth in communication from Jared and Evan, specifically noting that Jared has been much louder and more vocal during the preseason.
clips.video_title: Cavs Practice | Kenny Atkinson Media Availability | 10.10.2026
clips.pull_quote: Jared and Evan, I don't know what they have taken a step up communication wise.

clips.speaker: Cormac Ryan
clips.text: It's been great. It's been great. We've had a really competitive camp. I think we've done a really good job building habits. Coach has been very clear with his expectations, with the standard that we want to set, and I think we've done a really good job responding to that, respecting it, and just building on it every day.
clips.news_angle: Cormac Ryan on Milwaukee Bucks training camp and team habits

clips.video_title: Cormac Ryan Media Availability | 10.09.26
clips.pull_quote: We've had a really competitive camp. I think we've done a really good job building habits.

clips.speaker: Cormac Ryan
clips.text: For me, the hunger and the effort doesn't waver. I was unsigned last year, I was playing just as hard as I am now. And when I sign a $50 million deal, I'll play just as hard as I do now. For me, that's just a non-negotiable and so I'm not too worried about what type of deal I'm on. I'm just worried about impacting winning.
clips.news_angle: Cormac Ryan on his commitment to winning regardless of contract
clips.social_post: Cormac Ryan says his effort remains the same regardless of his contract status. He says the hunger does not waver and he is focused on impacting winning.
clips.video_title: Cormac Ryan Media Availability | 10.09.26
clips.pull_quote: I'm not too worried about what type of deal I'm on. I'm just worried about impacting winning.

clips.speaker: Cormac Ryan
clips.text: For me, it starts with effort and energy, competitiveness, so coming in bringing fire. Obviously, it's drilling shots, continuing to use my gravity as a shooter to help the team, and make plays, make the right reads, and compete defensively. I'm a guy who can really guard the ball and pick up and help us get stops. And then in between all of that, it's just the little things: talking, diving on the floor, boxing out, the unsexy things, and those are the things that help you win games.
clips.news_angle: Cormac Ryan on his role and impact on the Bucks
clips.social_post: Cormac Ryan describes his role with the Bucks as bringing energy and competitiveness. He highlights his focus on shooting gravity, guarding the ball, and doing the unsexy things like diving on the floor.
clips.video_title: Cormac Ryan Media Availability | 10.09.26
clips.pull_quote: I'm a guy who can really guard the ball and pick up and help us get stops.

clips.speaker: Cormac Ryan
clips.text: It's great. We get to push each other every day. We've got guys at all different stages of their career. So there's a lot of experience, there's guys who are newer, there's guys who are younger, older, and all different skill sets. Everyone brings something different and we get to push each other every day. We get to make each other better and then we all get to go out and compete and help. We're all bought into what Taylor is bringing and the staff and the work.
clips.news_angle: Cormac Ryan on the depth and chemistry of the Bucks
clips.social_post: Cormac Ryan praises the depth and chemistry of the Bucks roster, noting that the mix of experience and different skill sets allows the players to push each other every day.
clips.video_title: Cormac Ryan Media Availability | 10.09.26
clips.pull_quote: We've got guys at all different stages of their career. Everyone brings something different.

clips.speaker: Cormac Ryan
clips.text: I think we were proud of the way we pulled out the win. That was a great test in the preseason to start executing in late-game situations. There were things we worked on in practice that we got to carry over to the game right away, which is awesome to be in those situations. Being able to make the right play down the stretch, whether that's a go-ahead basket, getting a stop, rebounding, executing a side out of bounds, those are all things we work on every day.
clips.news_angle: Cormac Ryan on executing in late-game situations

clips.text: I think we just learned that we're hungry, we're competitive. I think we have a chip on our shoulder. I think we're resilient.
